# News Release


7/8/2026


South Bow Announces Timing of Second-quarter 2026 Results and Conference Call and Webcast


CALGARY, Alta. – July 8, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) will release its second-quarter 2026 financial and operational results after the close of markets on Aug. 5, 2026.
